import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

# Prepare the data for regression
X = hispanic_men[['DISSAVED']].values.reshape(-1, 1)  # Predictor (time preference)
y = hispanic_men['BMI'].values  # Response (BMI)

# Create a linear regression model
model = LinearRegression()
model.fit(X, y)

# Get the coefficient
coefficient = model.coef_[0]

# Calculate residuals
residuals = y - model.predict(X)

# Calculate standard error of the coefficient
n = len(X)
k = 1  # Number of predictors
std_error = np.sqrt(np.sum(residuals**2) / (n - k - 1) * (1 / (np.sum((X - np.mean(X))**2))))

# Calculate t-statistic
t_statistic = coefficient / std_error

# Calculate p-value using t-distribution
from scipy.stats import t
p_value = 2 * t.sf(abs(t_statistic), df=n - k - 1)

p_value
